title: Origins: Golemite
description: Origin datapack that adds the Golemite, an origin based on the Copper Golem.
body:
Origin datapack that adds the Golemite, an origin based on the Copper Golem.

Born of copper and powered by the resources that fuel the world, Golemites are efficient workers, given the proper maintenance.

NOTE: This Origin was made with multiplayer in mind and may not play as well in singleplayer.

![Golemite Power List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1f461871ab3ee395caf49c25d2a5ca3fb74d7726.png)
